STATE-BUTTON.cause: Button hover, press and focus colours differ from the draft: the live sgs-button paints framework default hover/press looks the draft does not (hover lighten or invert), or lacks the draft inverted hover (careers Register interest). Measured by real mouse, mouse-down and focus on every paired a/button on 1440.
STATE-BUTTON.status_note: 28 differ only in the press (:active) look, 18 in hover/focus/rest. Settings exist: sgs/button colourTextHover, colourBackgroundHover, borderColourHover (css_state hover in the framework DB); the press look has no block setting and goes through the theme snapshot (fill-state.mjs header: a press look on a button goes to the snapshot).

coverage.by_animations_json_record: every paired draft element has a TR record (46 of 46); 16 carry a record whose trigger matches the differing state
coverage.by_token_or_surfaces: press look: snapshot (theme-snapshot.json) is the sanctioned carrier

future_clone.why: Fill already writes a draft state look into the setting that holds that state and writes the draft rest value where the block would change a property the draft does not (holdDefaults); the press look is routed to the snapshot. Indus still shows 46 differing buttons, so the pass either skipped these or its writes were overwritten; the applier is the existing pass run to completion, not new code.

STATE-FORM-FIELD-REST-AND-FOCUS.cause: Form text and select controls: rest ink/label colours and backgrounds differ from the draft on all four forms (field text, label colour, field background hex vs slug), and the focus look differs (draft: white bg, blue border, 4px halo box-shadow; live: UA/site ring, bg unchanged). AP2, CN3, CN4, CT1.
STATE-FORM-FIELD-REST-AND-FOCUS.status_note: 35 = 24 text/select fields (apply 5, contact 5, catalogue 7, careers 7; step 1 only) + 11 labels (apply 2, catalogue 3, contact 5, careers 1), every one differing at rest. The 24 fields also differ in focus (outline/box-shadow halo: no form setting holds a 4px halo; the motion Focus state sets border and background only), so those 24 count in both statuses. Rest colours are settable (sgs/form fieldTextColour, labelColour, fieldBackground take a hex).

coverage.by_animations_json_record: TR-110/PS-010/PS-011 (Apply input, select), TR-121/PS-014 (Contact): focus look recorded; labels have no record
coverage.by_token_or_surfaces: rest colours are plain draft computed values (no token)

future_clone.why: The halo has no setting, so a clone can never carry it; the rest colours are carried only when Fill pairs each field to its draft input, which the form surfaces do for step 1.

STATE-FORM-FIELD-REST-AND-FOCUS.unmeasured: Apply steps 2 to 5: the draft run stopped after step 2 on my generic fill (validation), live reached step 6; those fields are not compared.
